Descaling, also known as descaling or cleaning, involves removing the built-up mineral deposits (lime scale) from your coffee maker's internal parts, including the water reservoir, tubes, and brewing chamber.

**Why is Descaling Necessary?**
Mineral buildup can lead to problems such as:

3. **Mix the descale solution**: In a large container, mix 1 part of descaling solution with 4 parts of water (for example: 50/50 ratio). If using white vinegar, fill the mixture to the top of the reservoir or tank.

2.  **Fitbit Community Forum**: The Fitbit community forum is an excellent resource where you can connect with other users, ask questions, and share experiences. You can find the forum at [forums.fitbit.com](http://forums.fitbit.com). Search for topics related to your issue or start a new thread.
3.  **Fitbit Mobile App**: If you have the Fitbit mobile app installed on your device, you can access in-app support within the settings menu (Settings > Help & Feedback). You'll find links to online resources, troubleshooting guides, and FAQs specific to your device.
4.  **Reset and Troubleshooting Guide**: For general reset and troubleshooting steps, refer to the Fitbit Aria user manual or search for a reset guide on the official Fitbit website.
5.  **Contact Fitbit Support**: If you've tried all the above resources and still need assistance, contact Fitbit support directly through their website ([www.fitbit.com/support/contact](http://www.fitbit.com/support/contact)). They offer phone and email support Monday to Friday during standard business hours.

By following these steps, you should be able to find help and troubleshooting information for your Fitbit Aria Wi-Fi Smart Scale.
